GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bumped @ start. Rolled fwd before raced behind leaders Two Wide (2L from lead) early . Tracked leaders Two Wide midrace until pushed to quicken 3 Wide @ 500m. Pushed along Six Wide (2L from lead) on home turn. Pressured & challenged leaders @ 200m. No match for winner in last 100m. # Every Chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped on jumping. Jockey reported that his mount was inclined to lay out throughout the event. A post-race veterinary examination revealed no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped only fairly, Eased & Settled Down 4.5 Lengths Two Wide , little change to 5 Lengths Two Wide turning, Held Up home turn then steered one lane short of centre of track Straightening Up , kept coming in Straight # battled on ok
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began only fairly. Passing the 800m was steadied after improving onto heels. Was unable to improve approaching and rounding the home turn when held up on heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped evenly. Not pushed early & raced Worse than midfield on inside (6L from lead). Stayed same until improving on inside from 600m. Two Wide @ 450m & pushed to quicken Four Wide (4L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Four Wide @ 250m & chased steadily in last 200m. # Sound for further.
Jumped Ok Ridden Along Went Forward Settled Down 1 Lengths Clear same to straightening up Under Pressure challenged x 300m, dueled - # run ended 100m
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped on jumping. Over raced in the middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 1 length Two Wide , held together much same to turn Two Wide trailing 0.75 Lengths , hit Lead Straightening Up , edged clear early in Straight and got away an extra length or So over the final 100m. (Blinkers FIRST TIME) # solid win

Away well. Pushed fwd & over-raced behind leader on inside (2L from lead). Tracked leader on inside midrace & pushed to quicken on inside (2L from lead) on home turn. Held up @ 250m & pressured 3 Wide @ 200m. Chased well in last 100m but just fell short. # Unlucy.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Over-raced throughout the middle stages. Near the 250m, after being disappointed for a run, was steadied when awkwardly placed on heels before shifting out to obtain clear running.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow out 1 length and Settled Down 4 Lengths Two Wide , Drifted Back to 5 Lengths Two Wide turning, hooked wider Straightening Up and Made Some Ground in Straight # slow start no help
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bounded on jumping. Eased when tightened for room shortly after. Steadied after improving onto heels passing the 1100m. Eased away from heels at the entrance to the straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped well. Pushed fwd & raced behind leaders on inside (2L from lead) early . Tracked leader on inside midrace & pushed along Two Wide (2L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Two Wide @ 250m & outsprinted in last 150m. # Every Chance
